notes.title: Z-Exemplar Update Now Available
notes.notes:
Hail Pilots!

A new update is now available for Z-Exemplar which includes a number of additional features, tweaks and bug fixes that should make your mission run just that tad smoother.

As ever, if you have any questions or queries then don't hesitate to get in touch..

For the Glory of Zed!

Suminell.
